tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for participating. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about your work-life balance. First, can you share one or two strategies that you use that you think are effective in managing your work-life balance?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您的参与。今天我想请教一些关于您工作与生活平衡的问题。首先，您能否分享一两个您认为在管理工作与生活平衡方面行之有效的方法？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Many companies are now developing programs to help employees manage work-life balance. Would programs like this affect your interest in working for a particular company? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。现在很多公司都在推出相关项目，帮助员工平衡工作与生活。这类项目会影响你对某家公司的求职意向吗？为什么会或为什么不会？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Some companies also offer flexible working hours or remote work options to help employees achieve a better work-life balance, but they are concerned that these options would reduce employee attention to tasks or engagement in the workplace. Do you think such programs are a good strategy for companies? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：挺有意思的。有些公司也会提供弹性工作时间或远程办公选项，帮助员工更好地平衡工作与生活，但他们担心这类安排会降低员工对工作任务的专注度，或是减少在工作场所的参与度。你认为这类举措对公司而言是好策略吗？为什么是或为什么不是？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Lastly, looking to the future, do you think people's attitudes towards work-life balance will change? For example, do you think people will prioritize personal life over work, or work over personal life? Explain your thoughts.
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得很有道理。最后，展望未来，你认为人们对工作与生活平衡的态度会发生改变吗？例如，你认为人们会更优先考虑个人生活而非工作，还是更看重工作而非个人生活？请解释你的想法。
tasks.title: Interview
